cg_officer.text: Crosby's sands look friendly, but the tide comes in fast across the flats and the mud's soft near the channel. We get called out to people stuck by the iron men, waiting to be rescued, looking very like an iron man themselves.
If you see someone in trouble at the coast, it's 999 and ask for the Coastguard. Same number for the lifeboat.

cg_volunteer.text: Each of the iron men weighs about 650 kilograms. The tide still moves them. We had one lean over like he'd had a long night. He's been straightened up since.
They're numbered, you know. Some of the far ones only show at low tide. You see more of them in the morning, when it's quiet and the light's low.
